How it plays

Six drivers, five minutes: the most land when the clock runs out wins. Drive out of your land and your car pays out a cable behind it; come back in to claim everything the cable encloses. If a rival drives over your cable while you are out, it snaps, a spark runs along it and your car goes up (back in a few seconds on a fresh patch).

Driving. Push the stick the way to go; push it further to go faster, let go to stop. BOOST gives a short burst (it recharges).

Structures stand at fixed spots: loop your land round one to own it and get its ability. Gun Armory guns (hold FIRE). Missile Silo (the centre) missiles: keep a rival in front to lock on. Mine Works mines behind you. Shield Generator a shield: no damage and your cable cannot be cut. Phase Drive a blink: a jump straight ahead, through barricades. Strike Uplink a strike: 1.4 s later it burns the ground; land there is lost and nobody can claim it for 20 s, and any cable through it is cut. EMP Tower an EMP: rival barricades round you drop, rival cars are jammed, rival missiles and mines die.

Barricades. Whether you get into a rival's land depends on the land you own. Small: barricades open for you. Middle: ram one square at the speed shown over your speed (the more land you own, the faster). Big: they hold; blink through, EMP them or shoot a gap.

Keyboard

W A S D or arrows to drive, Space to drift, F to fire, Shift to boost; E missile, Q mines, G shield, B blink, T strike, V EMP; C changes the view, R resets the car.
